prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant delicate thin black lines, slight organic variation, restrained internal detail and large white areas, not its Buddha shape. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY: the actual CHUANFA ZHENGZONG HALL 传法正宗殿 of YONG'AN TEMPLE 永安禅寺, Hunyuan, Shanxi, a Yuan-dynasty building of 1315.
Draw the single main hall from this real FRONT photograph, centered and straight-on with upright verticals. Preserve FIVE front bays divided by SIX column axes: THREE central tall wooden lattice door groups and ONE closed brick/plaster wall bay at each outer end. Keep the broad low single-eave HIP ROOF 庑殿顶, no exposed gable triangle and no second eave tier. Preserve the long gently curved front eave, deep projection, modest upswept corners, bold column-top brackets and the actual central double intermediate bracket rhythm. Keep the distinctive ridge-end dragon ornaments and the slender three-pronged central ridge finial, but render their ornament very selectively with sparse outline curves. Preserve the actual high rectangular platform and one narrow center stair flight. Remove the large incense burner that hides the stairs. Whole roof and platform must fit within the image.
IMPORTANT: remove all writing, including the giant wall calligraphy on the two outer bays, the hanging central plaque, column couplets and signage. The two end wall bays should be empty white planes. Do not replace them with more doors. Remove people, red ribbons, vessels, incense burners, stone lanterns, trees, plants, wires, modern signs, courtyard paving and every adjacent building. Show only this hall and its platform.
Refined sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE: very fine confident outer contours and still finer internal structural lines. All surfaces including doorways stay WHITE. No solid black fill, shadows, grey shading, hatching, crosshatching, pencil grain, texture, weathering, gradient, color or gold. Match the master visual density. Suggest lattice with only a few airy lines. Roof planes stay mostly blank with only 12-16 widely spaced roof-slope lines; never draw every tile or brick. Keep only essential architectural details. No invented features, lettering, calligraphy, watermark, caption, frame or border.
Landscape 1536 x 1024. Complete monument centered and about 82 percent of canvas width, generous balanced white margins, roof/apex and base uncut. A few short ground lines only.

site_recommendation.coordinate_note: 寺院近似位置，非单体测绘坐标。
site_recommendation.lede: 永安禅寺的传法正宗殿以宽阔庑殿屋顶压住五间立面，脊饰与深檐相映。元延祐二年营建的殿堂内，水陆壁画汇集儒释道人物，木构与绘画共同构成浑源古城的珍贵遗存。
facts: 永安寺始建于金代；现存传法正宗殿由高璞在元延祐二年（1315）捐资营建。
正殿面阔五间，单檐庑殿顶；中三间设门，两端实墙保留大型书法题刻。
永安寺2001年列入第五批全国重点文物保护单位；传法正宗殿内保存水陆壁画。

verification: 已查看原照片与输出：五间六柱轴、中央三组格扇、两端空白实墙、单层庑殿屋顶及中央台阶；塔形脊饰与屋角、台基完整，无人物文字。
